proof_summary: Prefix masses are transformed into a reflected deficit array satisfying the floor-averaging recurrence \(D_N(t+1,k)=\lfloor(D_N(t,k)+D_N(t,k+1))/2\rfloor\), and stability is shown equivalent to \(D_N(t,0)>0\). Comparing the recurrences for \(N\) and \(N+1\) shows that their first positivity times satisfy \(T_N+1\le T_{N+1}\le T_N+2\), yielding the two possible increments.
